career_ladder.note: The Assistant Central Intelligence Officer Grade-II/Executive (ACIO-II/Exe) is the primary direct-entry executive officer cadre in the Intelligence Bureau (IB), India's premier internal security and counter-intelligence agency under the Ministry of Home Affairs. Officers progress through specialized operational, counter-intelligence, signals, and security administration roles into senior gazetted leadership.

exam_scheme.note: Selection to ACIO-II/Exe is structured across three stages: Tier-I Online Computer Based Test (CBT) consisting of 100 objective MCQs (100 marks, 60 minutes) across five components; Tier-II Descriptive Written Examination (50 marks, 60 minutes) comprising Essay, English Comprehension, and Précis writing; and Tier-III Interview / Personality Test (100 marks) along with Psychometric profiling.

papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 33% (17 out of 50 marks) in Tier-II required to qualify for Tier-III

papers.qualifying_threshold: Combined aggregate of Tier-I (100) + Tier-II (50) + Tier-III (100) = 250 marks determines final merit

financial_package.note: ACIO-II/Exe is placed in Central Civil Services Pay Matrix Level 7 (₹44,900 – ₹1,42,400). A distinguishing financial benefit of Intelligence Bureau service is the Special Security Allowance (SSA) @ 20% of basic pay, admissible in addition to standard central government dearness allowance, HRA, and travel allowance, as well as cash compensation in lieu of duty performed on holidays/round-the-clock shifts up to a maximum of 30 days per annum.
financial_package.pay_source_label: MHA / Intelligence Bureau — ACIO-II/Exe Recruitment Notice (Advt 2023)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 7 entry basic pay of ₹44,900: Dearness Allowance @ 58% is ₹26,042; Special Security Allowance (SSA) @ 20% of basic is ₹8,980; HRA spans 10% (₹4,490 in Z class) to 30% (₹13,470 in X class); Transport Allowance spans ₹1,800 + DA to ₹3,600 + DA (₹5,688). Gross monthly earnings range from ~₹92,000 to ₹1,08,000. In-hand pay after 10% NPS deduction (₹7,094) and income tax withholding is approx. ₹82,000 to ₹95,000.
official_perks: Special Security Allowance (SSA) @ 20% of basic pay payable without any ceiling
Cash compensation in lieu of duty performed on declared gazetted holidays (up to a ceiling of 30 days in a financial year)
Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS) comprehensive indoor and outdoor medical facilities for self and dependants
Government residential quarter allotment or Central HRA (10% to 30%) by location tier
Children Education Allowance (CEA) of ₹2,250 per month per child and Hostel Subsidy
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% monthly employer contribution by Government of India
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and Annual Leave encashment entitlements
